description: A Flutter widget named FitnessCarousel that displays a horizontally scrollable list of workout cards, each representing a workout with its title, difficulty, duration, and exercises. It uses external models and a focusable card widget.

classes.name: FitnessCarousel
classes.description: A stateless widget that renders a horizontally scrollable list of workout cards, handling user interaction and layout styling.

methods.name: FitnessCarousel
methods.description: Constructor for the FitnessCarousel widget, requiring a list of workouts and a tap callback.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the carousel, creating a list view of focusable workout cards.
